shared_elements: shallow incised/low-relief curvilinear lines on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic carved motifs built from curved and arced lines, and both include roughly rounded/ring-like forms, but that is about as generic as carved decoration gets. A is a scatter of faint, loosely placed incised marks with no clear organising figure, whereas B is a coherent anthropomorphic figure whose back bears a deliberate symmetrical scheme of paired rings, a central disc and a horizontal banded belt with pendant elements — a structured composition with no counterpart in A.
